description_en: Pushes an upgrade message to all device models under a specified version by calling PushVersionMessage
description_zh: 调用PushVersionMessage给某一版本下的所有机型推送升级消息
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc push-version-message --project-id P0VFCREU --version-id 1 --version-type FOTA --region cn-hangzhou
name: PushVersionMessage

parameters.description_en:
The version type. Valid values:

- **FOTA**: system version.
- **APP**: application version.
parameters.description_zh:

- **FOTA**：系统版本
- **APP**：应用版本
